groundReference.type: Calibrated display plane of this example: native visible ground 421.1 m plus display offset -28 m
groundReference.purpose: Display water reference after placement; not measured ground

water: Water is a visual offset from the placed example display plane, not a measured water level; no real flood event or hydraulic calculation is implied. Custom OBB models keep their own box reference.

displayAlignment.purpose: Visual placement of the default public example only; not a vertical datum conversion or survey control
displayAlignment.evidence: Strict target-model depth probe: 47 valid hits, minimum 421.084 m, lower quartile 425.930 m. Nine level-14 terrain samples: 387.47-395.65 m, median 392.67 m. Native OBB minimum 403.91 m lies below the sampled visible plaza and is not a reliable ground surface.

knownLimitations: Low-angle views still show stretched mesh edges and photogrammetry holes in the public sample. The display translation cannot repair source mesh reconstruction defects.
